inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item to be retrieved.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given index.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state at the given index.

components.summary: 旧版按索引取项组件，保留用于兼容旧画布。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Item From Index
components.info: Find an item in a list, based on its index.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item to be retrieved.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given index.

components.summary: 按索引位置从列表中取出数据项。

detail.concept: 按序号从列表里取出一项。索引从 0 开始，所以第 1 项是索引 0。它是「只取一个」的入口，和「取一段」（子列表）、「取一枝」（树的分支）要区分开。
steps: 把列表接到输入。
给一个整数索引：0 表示第一项。
如果索引超出范围，输出会是空值，不会报错。

scenes.title: 固定取首项
scenes.body: 取列表第一项作为基准值，后续所有尺寸都相对于它计算。

scenes.title: 逐项遍历
scenes.body: 索引接一个整数序列，一次取出多个位置的项。

pitfalls: 负数索引不是「倒数第几」，会得到空值。
接的是树时，索引对每一枝分别生效，而不是对整棵树。
detail.tip: 索引 0 = 第一项，这个「差 1」是新手最常犯的错。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Item From Site
components.info: Find an item in a tree, based on its site.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given site.

outputs.name: Null

components.summary: 按树中的位置取出对应的数据项。

components.name: List From Index

outputs.name: List
outputs.info: The list at the given index.

components.summary: 按索引从树中取出一条「小枝」（子列表）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: List From Path
components.info: Find a list, or 'twig', based on its path within a tree.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.info: Path of the list to be retrieved.

outputs.name: List
outputs.info: The list at the given path.

components.summary: 按路径从树中取出一条「小枝」（子列表）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Meta From Index
components.info: Find meta data in a list, based on its index.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List of value and meta pairs.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of item whose meta data to retrieve.

outputs.name: Metadata
outputs.info: The meta data of the item at the given index.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state of the meta data at the given index.

components.summary: 按索引从列表中取出对应的元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Meta From Site
components.info: Find meta data in a tree, based on its site.

inputs.name: Tree
inputs.info: Tree of value and meta pairs.

inputs.name: Site
inputs.info: Site of meta data to retrieve.

outputs.name: Metadata
outputs.info: The meta data of the item at the given site.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state of the meta data at the given site.

components.summary: 按树中的位置取出对应的元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Combine
components.info: Replace the null values in the first list with the parallel values of following lists. This component functions as the inverse of the Sift component. The Sift and Combine components are the preferred tools for conditional logic in Grasshopper.
components.summary: 用后续列表的对应值填补第一个列表中的空值，是 Sift 的逆操作。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dispatch
components.info: Dispatch values to one of two outputs based on a boolean pattern.

outputs.name: True
outputs.info: Destination output for all items matched up with a `true` pattern value.

outputs.name: False
outputs.info: Destination output for all items matched up with a `false` pattern value.

components.summary: 按布尔规则把数据分到两个输出：为真的走一路，为假的走另一路。

detail.concept: 分流：给一个布尔模式，把数据按「真 / 假」分成两路输出。它是 GH2 里做条件处理的标准工具——先把条件算成布尔值，再用它把数据分拨到不同逻辑。
steps: 把要分拨的数据接到列表输入。
把布尔值列表接到模式输入；数量不够时会循环使用。
两路输出分别接不同的下游逻辑：真的一路、假的一路。
需要合回一条时，用合并补空（Combine）把空缺填上。

scenes.title: 按朝向筛选立面
scenes.body: 算出每个立面的法向与目标方向的点积，大于 0 的走「朝阳」一路加遮阳。

scenes.title: 奇偶分组
scenes.body: 用取余结果做布尔值，把列表拆成奇偶两组分别处理。

pitfalls: 布尔值与数据数量不一致时，GH2 会循环使用模式，结果常与直觉不符。
分流后两路的顺序都被重排，需要保持索引时请把索引一起分流。
detail.tip: Sift + Combine 是 GH2 做条件逻辑的一对标准工具，比一堆筛选组件更好维护。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Entwine
components.info: Combine inputs into a single output tree using a variety of mechanisms.
components.summary: 用多种方式把多路输入合并成同一棵输出树。

detail.concept: 把多路输入合并成一棵树，每路各占一条分支。与普通合并的区别在于它保留了「哪一路」这个信息。
steps: 把若干路列表分别接进不同输入。
选择合并方式（按输入分组、按项分组等）。
输出是一棵带分组结构的树，下游可以按组分别计算。

scenes.title: 多方案并列
scenes.body: 把三个方案的体块合成一棵树，统一预览但保持可分别控制。

pitfalls: 不同合并方式会得到完全不同的树结构，改之前先看输出。
分组后下游组件会对每枝各算一次，数据量成倍增长。
detail.tip: 要「分组」用编织成树，要「合并」用合并列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Merge
components.info: Merge the values from several inputs into a single output.
components.summary: 把多路输入的数据合并成一个输出列表。

detail.concept: 把多路输入合并成一条输出，顺序按输入端口从左到右。它是「多股合成一股」的标准做法，和「连接」（把同类型数据前后拼接）在语义上接近，但更强调输入路数。
steps: 把若干列表分别接到不同输入。
输出是一条按输入顺序排列的列表。
需要保持分组时改用「合并成树」（Entwine）。

scenes.title: 合并多组曲线
scenes.body: 把几路筛选结果合并后统一放样或统一预览。

scenes.title: 按顺序拼接
scenes.body: 把上下两段多段线合并成一条连续点序。
scenes.wiring: 上半段点 + 下半段点 → Merge

pitfalls: 合并会丢层级，原本分属不同树的数据会被压成一条。
合并后索引全部改变，之前记下的索引不再有效。
detail.tip: 合并是「并列」，交织（Weave）是「交替」，别用错。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Pick And Mix
components.info: Build a list by picking items one at a time from two or more input lists.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Picking pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked. The output will contain as many items as there are elements in the pattern.

components.summary: 从多个输入列表里轮流取项，组成新列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Pick And Omit
components.info: Build a list by picking from competing items in two or more input lists.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Picking pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked. The output will contain as many items as there are elements in the pattern.

components.summary: 在多个输入列表的竞争项中取一个、舍一个地组成新列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sift
components.info: Sift a list of items using an output index pattern. This component functions as the inverse of the Combine component. The Sift and Combine components are the preferred tools for conditional logic in Grasshopper.
components.summary: 按一个索引规则把列表分流到多个输出，是 Combine 的逆操作。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Weave
components.info: Weave a list by interspersing values from two or more input lists in a particular repeating pattern.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Weaving pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked.

components.summary: 按重复规则把多路输入的数据交错编织成一个列表。

detail.concept: 按重复规则把多路数据交错编织成一条列表。AB 两路、规则 1:1 就是交替排列；1:2 就是一路插一个、另一路插两个。
steps: 把若干路列表接到不同输入。
给编织规则（每路连续取几项）。
输出为交织后的单条列表。

scenes.title: 交替排布
scenes.body: 把两种尺寸的构件交替排列，形成节奏感。

pitfalls: 规则长度与输入路数不一致时，多出的输入会被忽略。
两路数量不等时，短的一路会提前耗尽。
detail.tip: 想要「一长一短」交替，就用规则 1:2 去编织。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Frequency
components.info: Remove every Nth item from a list.

inputs.name: Frequency
inputs.info: Culling frequency. From a given starting point, every Nth item will be culled.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.info: Index of first item to cull. If no start is given, culling begins at the last item of the first cycle, so every Nth item is culled.

components.summary: 每隔 N 项删掉一项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Index
components.info: Remove all specified items from a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be culled.

components.summary: 删除指定位置上的所有项。

detail.concept: 按索引剔除列表中的项。给要删的序号，其余保留。
steps: List 端接数据。
Indices 端接要剔除的索引（可多个）。
输出剩余项。

scenes.title: 去掉首尾多余点
scenes.body: 等分得到的点里去掉第一个与最后一个，让布点不贴边。

pitfalls: 索引超出范围会静默忽略，不会报错提醒。
多个索引同时剔除时按原列表编号，不受删除顺序影响。
detail.tip: 只删固定位置用 Cull Index，按条件删用 Cull Pattern。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Pattern
components.info: Remove all indicated items from a list.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Culling pattern. Items paired up with the value `false` in the pattern are retained, while those paired up with the value `true` are culled.

components.summary: 按一串真/假标记删除对应位置的项。

detail.concept: 给一串真/假标记，删掉标记为「假」的项。与分流不同，它只输出一路——保留下来的那一批，适合「只要满足条件的」。
steps: 接数据列表与布尔模式。
模式为真的项被保留，为假的被删除。
想反过来保留，把模式接一个非门取反即可。

scenes.title: 只保留大面积面板
scenes.body: 算出每块面板面积，与阈值比较得到布尔列表，剔除小面板。
scenes.wiring: 面积 → 大于阈值 → Cull By Pattern

scenes.title: 去掉越界点
scenes.body: 判断点是否落在边界内，把界外的点剔除。

pitfalls: 模式长度不足时会循环，删除结果可能比预期多。
删除后索引全部前移，不能再用原索引去取原始数据。
detail.tip: 「筛选」和「分流」的区别：只要一份结果用筛选，要两份用分流。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Sites
components.info: Remove a specific set of items from a tree.

inputs.name: Sites
inputs.info: Sites of tree items to be removed.

outputs.name: Culled Tree
outputs.info: Tree with the specified items removed.

components.summary: 按给定的一组位置从树中删除对应项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Value
components.info: Remove all items which are equal to one or more filter values.

inputs.name: Filter Values
inputs.info: Values to remove from the list.

components.summary: 删除所有等于给定值（可给多个）的项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull Consecutive
components.info: Delete consecutive identical values from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List with repeated values to cull.

inputs.name: Cyclical
inputs.info: Treat the list as a cyclical collection.

components.summary: 删除列表中连续出现且相同的值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull Nulls
components.info: Remove all null values from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose null values to remove.

components.summary: 删除列表中的所有空值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cull By Probability
components.info: Remove items from a list probabilistically.

inputs.name: Probability
inputs.info: Probability function between zero (definitely keep) and one (definitely cull). The function is evaluated at the list's indices to yield per-item probabilities.

components.summary: 按给定概率随机删除列表中的项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Random Reduce
components.info: Randomly remove a set number of elements from a list.

inputs.name: Remove
inputs.info: Optional number of items to remove. If unspecified, the `Retain` input must be set.

inputs.name: Retain
inputs.info: Optional number of items to retain. If unspecified, the `Remove` input must be set.

components.summary: 随机删除指定数量的元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Random Select
components.info: Randomly select a number of elements from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List of items to select from.

components.summary: 从列表中随机抽取指定数量的元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: List Length
components.info: Count the number of items contained in a list, including all null values.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of values and nulls in the list.

components.summary: 统计列表中包含的项数，空值也计入。

detail.concept: 统计一个列表里到底有多少项，空值也计入。它是排查问题最常用的工具：几乎所有「结果数量不对」的判断，都从看这个数开始。
steps: 把列表接到 Count 端口。
读右侧输出的数字：这就是该项的数据量。
把它接给 Panel 或直接悬停端口，对照上游预期值排查。

scenes.title: 核对数据量
scenes.body: 在分流或筛选之后接一个长度组件，确认输出数量是否与预期一致。

scenes.title: 驱动循环数量
scenes.body: 把另一条链路的长度作为区间数量，让两侧数据量自动对齐。

pitfalls: 它统计的是「项」不是「唯一值」，重复项会被计入。
接树时每枝各算一次，输出本身也是列表——想看总数要先拍平。
detail.tip: 养成「每段结尾看一眼数量」的习惯，能省掉一半调试时间。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: List Statistics
components.info: Measure various statistics of the items contained in a list.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of items in the list.

outputs.name: Values
outputs.info: Number of actual, non-null values in the list.

outputs.name: Nulls
outputs.info: Number of nulls in the list.

outputs.name: Metas
outputs.info: Number of values with associated meta data.

components.summary: 统计列表的多项指标（长度、空值数、首个末个等）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Bracket List
components.info: Insert a value at the start or the end of a list, or both.

inputs.name: Prepend
inputs.info: Optional value to add to the start of the list.

inputs.name: Append
inputs.info: Optional value to add to the end of the list.

components.summary: 在列表开头、结尾或首尾各插入一个值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Expand
components.info: Lengthen a list by repeating its items according to a specified repetition method.
components.summary: 按指定的重复规则把列表拉长。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Insert Into List
components.info: Insert values into a list at indexed locations.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.info: Values to insert. If not specified, nulls will be inserted.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Insertion indices for each item. The indices refer to positions in the original list.

components.summary: 在指定索引位置向列表中插入数值。

detail.concept: 在列表的指定位置插入新项，原有项依次后移。
steps: List 端接原列表。
设置插入位置。
接要插入的项，输出新列表。

scenes.title: 补一个基准点
scenes.body: 在定位点列表开头插入原点，保证序列从 0 开始。

pitfalls: 插入后所有后续索引都会变，依赖索引的逻辑要一起改。
树结构按分支分别插入，不跨分支。
detail.tip: 插项会打乱索引，尽量在流程早段做完。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Permutations
components.info: Create various permutations of a list.

inputs.name: Limit
inputs.info: Maximum number of permutations to generate.

inputs.name: Random
inputs.info: Optional random engine to use for permutation ordering.

outputs.name: Permutations
outputs.info: Tree containing permutations of the input list.

components.summary: 生成列表元素的各种排列结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Repeat Items
components.info: Repeat the items in a list a fixed number of times.

inputs.name: Repetitions
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

inputs.name: Repeat List
inputs.info: If true, the list as a whole is repeated, keeping the ordering of items mostly intact.

components.summary: 把列表中的每一项重复固定的次数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Repeat Items
components.info: Repeat the items in a list a fixed number of times.

inputs.name: Repetitions
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

components.summary: 旧版逐项重复组件，保留用于兼容旧画布。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Repeat List
components.info: Repeat a list until a given new length is reached.
components.summary: 整条列表重复到指定长度为止。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Resize List
components.info: Resize a list by repeating its items until a given length is reached.

inputs.name: Repeat List
inputs.info: If true, the list as a whole is repeated, keeping the ordering of items mostly intact.

components.summary: 把列表反复重复直到达到指定长度。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shrink
components.info: Shorten a list by removing items according to a specified culling method.
components.summary: 按指定剔除方式缩短列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Stack Items
components.info: Duplicate items in a list a given a number of times.

inputs.name: Stacking Pattern
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

components.summary: 把列表中的项按给定次数逐项复制堆叠。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Fragment List
components.info: Break a list of items into consecutive fragments at specified indices.
components.summary: 在指定索引处把列表切成若干连续片段。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Partition List
components.info: Divide a list into consecutive shorter lists, using a specified pattern.

outputs.name: Segments
outputs.info: Consecutive parts of the original list.

components.summary: 按指定规则把列表切成若干较短的子列表。

detail.concept: 按给定规则把一条长列表切成若干短列表，形成树。做「每 N 个一组」的阵列、分行、分排时，这是最直接的工具。
steps: 接数据列表。
给分组大小（每组几项），必要时给步距（每组之间跳几项）。
输出变成树，每个分支是一组；下游组件会按组分别计算。

scenes.title: 点阵分行
scenes.body: 把一维点序列按每行 10 个切分，得到分行的树。

scenes.title: 每层分组
scenes.body: 按楼层数量把构件分组，逐层生成体块。

pitfalls: 最后不足一组的项会单独成枝，数量可能比预期多一枝。
分组大小与总项数不成倍数时，请检查尾组是否需要剔除。
detail.tip: 先算清「每组的数量」再动手，比事后剪枝省事。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Punch List
components.info: Exclude a contiguous set of items from a list.

inputs.name: First Index
inputs.info: Index of first value to be excluded.

inputs.name: Second Index
inputs.info: Index of last value to be excluded.

outputs.name: Punched List
outputs.info: List containing only the items before and after the excluded range.

components.summary: 从列表中整段排除连续的若干项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Snip List
components.info: Shorten a list by removing leading and/or trailing items.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.info: Number of items to remove from the beginning of the list.

inputs.name: End
inputs.info: Number of items to remove from the end of the list.

components.summary: 从列表开头或结尾去掉若干项来缩短列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Split List
components.info: Split a list of items into two parts at a specified index.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of first item in the second output list.

outputs.name: First List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list that comes before the splitting index.

outputs.name: Second List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list starting at the splitting index.

components.summary: 在指定索引处把列表切成前后两段。

detail.concept: 在指定位置把一列数据切成两段，前半段与后半段分别输出。
steps: List 端接数据列表。
设置切分索引。
输出 A、B 两段。

scenes.title: 分成上下两部分
scenes.body: 把排序后的楼层在中间一刀切开，分别处理裙房与塔楼。
scenes.wiring: 楼层列表 → Split List → 两段

pitfalls: 索引为 0 时第一段为空，后续组件会拿到空列表。
索引从 0 开始计数，与「第几个」差一。
detail.tip: 分组先排序再切分，位置才稳定。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sub List
components.info: Extract from a list a section bounded by indices.

inputs.name: First Index
inputs.info: Index of the first value in the resulting sub list.

inputs.name: Second Index
inputs.info: Index of the last value in the resulting sub list.

outputs.name: Sub List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list between, and including, the bounding indices.

components.summary: 按起止索引从列表中截取一段。

detail.concept: 按起止索引从列表中截取一段，起止都包含在内。它是「只要中间那几项」的标准做法，比先拍平再过滤更直接。
steps: 接数据列表。
给起始索引与长度（或结束索引，看端口给的是哪种）。
输出就是截取出来的那一段；索引超出范围时返回空值而不是报错。

scenes.title: 取中间楼层
scenes.body: 从整栋楼的标高列表里截取第 3 到第 8 层单独做处理。

pitfalls: 索引从 0 开始，写 1 表示第二项。
结束索引超出列表长度时不会自动补齐。
detail.tip: 先看一眼 List Length，再填索引，能避免一半的空结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Longest List
components.info: Expand lists in a collection until they are all equally long.
components.summary: 把一组列表按最长的那条补齐，使长度一致。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shortest List
components.info: Shrink lists in a collection until they are all equally short.
components.summary: 把一组列表按最短的那条裁剪，使长度一致。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Find Similar
components.info: Find the value in a list which is most similar to a given value.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.info: List of values to search in.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value most similar to the given search criterion.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.info: Index of the most similar value.

components.summary: 在列表中找出与给定值最接近的那一项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Find Values
components.info: Find all indices where a specific value occurs in a list.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all items which match the search value.

components.summary: 找出某个值在列表中出现的所有位置。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Key Value Search
components.info: Find a matching key in a list and output the value associated with it.

inputs.name: Keys
inputs.info: List of keys to search in.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.info: List of associated values, one for each key.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value associated with the found key.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.info: Index of the found key, or -1 if no key matched the search.

components.summary: 按键在列表中查找并输出对应的值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Replace Indices
components.info: Replace items in a list by index.

inputs.name: Replacements
inputs.info: Replacing values. If not specified, the items will be replaced with nulls.

components.summary: 按索引位置替换列表中的项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Replace Nulls
components.info: Replace all the nulls in a list.
components.summary: 把列表中的所有空值替换成指定内容。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Replace Values
components.info: Replace values in a list with other values.
components.summary: 把列表中的指定值替换成其它值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Decode Index
components.info: Reorder items in a list based on their `Data.Index` meta data.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.info: List of items to be reordered.

components.summary: 按数据自带的索引元数据重新排列列表项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Encode Index
components.info: Assign the `Data.Index` meta data to all items in each list based on their current position.
components.summary: 按当前顺序为列表中每一项写入索引元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sort
components.info: Sort the values in a list based on their intrinsic sorting order.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 按数值自身的固有顺序对列表排序。

detail.concept: 按数值自身的顺序排序，并同时输出排序后的索引。那个索引很关键——它让你能把「别的列表」按同样的顺序重排，保持数据之间的对应关系。
steps: 把要排序的数值列表接进来。
得到排序后的值与被排序的原始索引。
把索引接给「按映射重排」，让与数值对应的几何也换到同一顺序。

scenes.title: 按高度排序楼层
scenes.body: 用楼板标高排序，得到从上到下的索引，再据此重排楼板。
scenes.wiring: 标高 → Sort → 索引 → 重排楼板

scenes.title: 按距离排序点
scenes.body: 算每个点到目标的距离后排序，取最近的几个。
scenes.wiring: 距离 → Sort → 索引 → 取前 N

pitfalls: 只用了排序后的值、忘了同步重排其它数据，会导致几何与数值错位。
文本排序请用按文本排序组件，混用会得到非预期顺序。
detail.tip: 排序永远成对使用：值 + 索引，索引才是把其它数据「带着一起走」的钥匙。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sort By Number
components.info: Reorder values based on a given numeric sorting order.
components.summary: 按给定的数值序列决定排序结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sort By Text
components.info: Reorder values based on a given textual sorting order.
components.summary: 按给定的文本序列决定排序结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sorting Key
components.info: Extract the sorting key of a given value. When collections contain differing or unknown types, items are sorted according to these keys, rather than type specific comparisons.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value whose sorting key to extract.

outputs.name: Key Fragments
outputs.info: Alternating textual and numeric fragments of the key.

components.summary: 取出某个值的排序键；混合类型集合按排序键而非类型比较。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Combine Maps
components.info: Combine two or more index maps into a single map.
components.summary: 把两个以上的索引映射合成为一个映射。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Identity Map
components.info: Create an identity index mapping for a list of a given length.

inputs.name: Length
inputs.info: Length of map. Negative lengths yield an index map which reverses the order of a list.

components.summary: 为指定长度的列表生成一个不变的索引映射。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Invert Map
components.info: Invert an index map. An inverted map undoes the changes indicated by the original map.
components.summary: 把索引映射取反，用来撤销原映射造成的变化。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Map Items
components.info: Reorder the items in a list as indicated by an index map.
components.summary: 按索引映射重新排列列表项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Churn
components.info: Randomly and cyclically shuffle the order of items in a list.

inputs.name: Vigour
inputs.info: Churning vigour. Zero means no shuffling at all, one equals total randomisation.

inputs.name: Random engine to use for churning.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 随机地把列表项做循环移位。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cycle
components.info: Cycle the items in a list by shifting them forwards or backwards.

inputs.name: Offset
inputs.info: Number of steps in the cycling process. Negative offsets move items backwards.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 把列表项整体向前或向后循环挪动若干位。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Reverse
components.info: Reverse the items in a list by inverting their order.
components.summary: 把列表项的顺序完全颠倒。

detail.concept: 把列表顺序倒过来。常用于修正「点序反了」的连线方向。
steps: List 端接数据。
输出倒序后的列表。

scenes.title: 修正曲线方向
scenes.body: 放样用的截面方向相反，倒序一次就能让所有截面朝向一致。

pitfalls: 倒序也影响所有并行列表，必须一起倒，否则数据错位。
嵌套树只倒分支内顺序，不改变分支顺序。
detail.tip: 凡是对齐问题，先试倒序，能解决一大半。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shake
components.info: Randomly shuffle the order of items in a list.

inputs.name: Vigour
inputs.info: Shaking vigour. Zero means no shuffling at all, one equals total randomisation.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 随机打乱列表中各项的顺序。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move To End
components.info: Move indicated items to the end of a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be moved to the end of the list.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 把指定的项移动到列表末尾。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move To Start
components.info: Move indicated items to the start of a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be moved to the start of the list.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 把指定的项移动到列表开头。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Swap Items
components.info: Swap the places of items in a list, pair by pair.

inputs.name: Index A
inputs.info: First index of each swapping pair.

inputs.name: Index B
inputs.info: Second index of each swapping pair.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

components.summary: 把列表中成对的项互换位置。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cross Reference
components.info: Cross reference values in multiple lists with each other.

outputs.name: Groups
outputs.info: Groups consisting of all cross-references value combinations.

components.summary: 把多个列表的值互相交叉组合，形成全组合表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Crossing Pairs
components.info: Create pairs out of the elements of a given list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose elements to pair up.

inputs.name: Omit Nulls
inputs.info: If true, omit any pairs containing null elements.

outputs.name: Primary Items
outputs.info: List containing the primary elements of all pairs.

outputs.name: Secondary Items
outputs.info: List containing the secondary elements of all pairs.

components.summary: 把列表中的元素两两配成对。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Offset Pairs
components.info: Pair up items in a given list based on an index offset.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose items to pair up.

inputs.name: First Offset
inputs.info: Offset of primary items. Positive offsets remove the leading items, while negative offsets remove the trailing items.

inputs.name: Second Offset
inputs.info: Offset of secondary items. Positive offsets remove the leading items, while negative offsets remove the trailing items.

outputs.name: Primary Items
outputs.info: List containing the primary elements of all pairs.

outputs.name: Secondary Items
outputs.info: List containing the secondary elements of all pairs.

components.summary: 按索引偏移把列表项两两配对。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Create Set
components.info: Create a valid set out of a list of values. Valid sets contain only unique elements.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: Source list containing all elements for the set.

outputs.name: Set
outputs.info: Set containing only the unique elements in the input list.

outputs.name: Filter
outputs.info: Retention filter applied to the input list.

components.summary: 把列表转成合法集合：只保留唯一值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Set Exclusion
components.info: Create the exclusion (or symmetric difference) of two sets. That is, a new set containing all the values which occur either in A or in B, but not both.

outputs.name: Exclusion
outputs.info: Set containing the elements present in either A, or B, but not both.

components.summary: 取只出现在 A 或只出现在 B 中的元素，两边共有的一律排除。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Set Intersection
components.info: Create the new set containing only the elements which occur in all inputs.

outputs.name: Intersection
outputs.info: Set containing the elements shared amongst all inputs.

components.summary: 取所有输入集合中共有的元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Set Subtraction
components.info: Create a set which contais only those elements from set A that do not also occur in set B. Note that duplicate elements in A will be retrained.

outputs.name: Remainder
outputs.info: Set containing the elements present in A, but not in B.

components.summary: 取属于 A 但不属于 B 的元素，A 中的重复项会保留。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cartesian Product
components.info: Create the cartesian product of two sets.

outputs.name: Product
outputs.info: Cartesian product of A⨯B, as a list of tuples.

components.summary: 把两个集合的每个元素两两组合，得到全部配对。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Disjoint Set
components.info: Test whether two sets are fully disjoint.

outputs.name: Disjoint
outputs.info: Disjoint state. If true, A and B share no values.

components.summary: 判断两个集合是否完全没有共同元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Set Majority
components.info: Find all values which appear in at least two out of three sets.

outputs.name: Majority
outputs.info: Set containing all values which appear in at least two of the inputs.

components.summary: 找出在三个集合中至少出现两次的值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Subset
components.info: Test whether one set is a proper subset of another.

outputs.name: Subset
outputs.info: Subset state. If true, all the values in B also appear in A.

components.summary: 判断一个集合是否为另一个集合的真子集。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Create Tuple
components.info: Combine several named values into a single tuple.
components.summary: 把若干个带名字的值组合成一个元组。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dissolve Tuple
components.info: Dissolve a tuple into individual values.
components.summary: 把元组拆回一个个独立的值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Grow Tuple
components.info: Add or overwrite a single element to a tuple of named values.
components.summary: 向元组中添加一个值，或覆盖同名的值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Pare Tuple
components.info: Remove from a tuple all elements whose names match the given pattern.
components.summary: 移除元组中名称符合给定规则的所有元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Peek Tuple
components.info: Find a single element in a tuple of named values using the element's name.

inputs.name: Element Name
inputs.info: Name of element to search for.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value of found element, or null if no element is found.

components.summary: 按名称从元组中取出单个元素。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tuple From List
components.info: Create a tuple out of all the items in a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List to convert into a tuple.

inputs.name: Element Name
inputs.info: Name for all elements. The index will be appended as a suffix to ensure uniqueness.

components.summary: 把列表中的所有项装成一个元组。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tuple From Pear
components.info: Create a tuple out of a value and its associated meta data.

inputs.name: Meta Data
inputs.info: Optional meta data to use in case the value input lacks meta data.

outputs.name: Tuple
outputs.info: Tuple containing the input value and the meta data.

components.summary: 把一个值连同它的元数据装成元组。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tuple To List
components.info: Create a list out of all the elements in a tuple.

inputs.name: Tuple
inputs.info: Tuple to convert to a list.

outputs.name: Items
outputs.info: List of items matching the tuple elements.

components.summary: 把元组中的所有元素输出成列表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tuple To Pear
components.info: Extract the value and meta data from a correctly formatted tuple.

inputs.name: Tuple
inputs.info: A tuple containing a value and a meta data element.

components.summary: 从格式正确的元组中取出值与其元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tree Length
components.info: Count the number of items contained in a tree, including all null values.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of values and nulls in the tree.

components.summary: 统计数据树包含的项数，空值也计入。

detail.concept: 统计树结构的规模：有多少分支、总共有多少项、分支最长多少。
steps: Tree 端接树数据。
从输出端口取分支数、项数等指标。

scenes.title: 检查拆解结果
scenes.body: 曲面拆成 UV 树后先看分支数对不对，再继续建模。

pitfalls: 项数是所有分支之和，不等于分支数乘以某项。
空分支也会计入分支数，容易误判结构正确。
detail.tip: 怀疑数据结构出错时，先量一量它的规模。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tree Statistics
components.info: Calculate various statistics of the items contained in a data tree.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of items in the tree.

outputs.name: Values
outputs.info: Number of actual values in the tree.

outputs.name: Nulls
outputs.info: Number of nulls in the tree.

outputs.name: Metas
outputs.info: Number of values with associated meta data.

components.summary: 统计数据树的各项指标（分支数、层数、项数等）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tree Topology
components.info: Extract the topology of a data tree.

outputs.name: List Count
outputs.info: Total number of lists in the tree.

outputs.name: List Paths
outputs.info: The path associated with each list.

components.summary: 取出数据树的拓扑结构。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Clean Tree
components.info: Clean a data tree by nulls, invalid items and empty twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Nulls
inputs.info: If true, null values are removed from all twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Invalids
inputs.info: If true, invalid values are removed from all twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Empty
inputs.info: If true, twigs with no leaves are removed.

outputs.name: Twig Difference
outputs.info: Number of twigs that were removed.

outputs.name: Item Difference
outputs.info: Number of items and nulls that were removed.

components.summary: 清除树中的空值、无效项与空枝。

detail.concept: 清理树结构里的空分支与空项，让后续操作不再被空数据干扰。
steps: Tree 端接树。
输出清理后的树。

scenes.title: 筛选后收拾残局
scenes.body: 按条件删掉大量项后，分支里剩下的空洞会影响下游，先清理再继续。

pitfalls: 清理会改变分支编号，依赖路径的下游逻辑要重新检查。
它是「删空」不是「补空」，缺少的结构不会自动补齐。
detail.tip: 每次大规模删除之后，都该接一次 Clean Tree。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Incremental Tree
components.info: Simplify the topology of a tree by restarting all path discontinuities at zero.
components.summary: 把路径中所有不连续处归零，简化树的拓扑。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Prune Tree
components.info: Prune a data tree by removing short or long branches.

inputs.name: Short Limit
inputs.info: Optional lower limit. Twigs with this many leaves or fewer will be removed.

inputs.name: Long Limit
inputs.info: Optional upper limit. Twigs with this many leaves or more will be removed.

inputs.name: Count Values
inputs.info: If true, only the non-null values are counted in each twig.

components.summary: 删除过长或过短的分支来精简数据树。

detail.concept: 裁剪树：按规则去掉分支里多余的项，例如每支只留前 N 个或后 N 个。
steps: Tree 端接树。
设置裁剪规则与数量。
输出裁剪后的树。

scenes.title: 每层只留前三个开间
scenes.body: 做局部方案对比时，只需每层前三个开间的数据。
scenes.wiring: 分层树 → Prune → 前 3 项

pitfalls: 裁剪按分支独立进行，不会跨分支取全局前 N。
规则方向（从头还是从尾）弄反会得到完全不同的结果。
detail.tip: Prune 管「每支留几个」，Trim 管「去掉几层」。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Renumber Tree
components.info: Modify the topology of a tree by incrementally renumbering all paths.
components.summary: 把所有路径按递增顺序重新编号，改变树的拓扑。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Simplify Tree
components.info: Simplify the topology of a tree by removing the elements shared by all paths.

inputs.name: Alignment
inputs.info: Path alignment in case of differently sized paths.

components.summary: 去掉所有路径共有的层级，只留下有区分度的部分。

detail.concept: 去掉所有路径共有的前缀层级，只留有区分度的部分。它不改变分组关系，只把「门牌号」改短。
steps: 接树。
拍平或整枝操作前常用它清理冗余层级。

scenes.title: 清理嵌套路径
scenes.body: 多级嵌套后路径太长，简化后再做按路径取枝。
scenes.wiring: 树 → Simplify → 按路径取枝

pitfalls: 如果路径本身不共享前缀，简化不会有任何变化。
简化只改路径不改数据，所以数量不会变。
detail.tip: 简化 = 改门牌号；想改结构请用拍平或嫁接。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Trim Tree
components.info: Trim a tree by merging lists which share the last N elements of their paths.
components.summary: 把路径末尾若干级相同的分支合并，精简树的层数。

detail.concept: 削减树层级：去掉路径的最外层（或若干层），把嵌套结构提升一级。
steps: Tree 端接嵌套树。
设置要削减的层数。
输出提升层级后的树。

scenes.title: 拆掉多余的分组层
scenes.body: 数据被多包了一层导致下游接不上，Trim 一层就恢复了。

pitfalls: 削太多层会把不同分组混在一起，数据关系永久丢失。
只看分支数看不出层级问题，用 Tree Paths 检查路径更准确。
detail.tip: 结构问题的第一诊断工具是 Tree Paths，不是 Trim。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Flatten Tree
components.info: Flatten a tree by moving all its items into a single list.
components.summary: 把树的所有数据项压进同一个列表，丢掉路径。

detail.concept: 拍平把所有分支的数据压进同一个列表，路径信息全部丢弃。当你不关心「哪个数据属于哪一组」、只想拿到全部数据时用它。
steps: 把树接进来。
输出变成单层列表，项数是所有分支项数之和。
后续组件不再按分支分别计算，而是对整批数据统一处理。

scenes.title: 统一求总长
scenes.body: 把多组曲线的长度拍平后求和，得到总长度。

scenes.title: 批量生成单张面
scenes.body: 把分组后的曲线拍平，一次性放样成一张面。

pitfalls: 拍平会丢分组，之后再想按原组处理就只能重建结构。
拍平放样看起来更方便，但截面顺序一旦错乱会扭面。
detail.tip: 拍平前先问一句：我之后还需要按组处理吗？需要就别拍。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Flip Tree
components.info: Flip a tree by swapping one of the numbers in the path of each item, with that item's list index. When the tree represents a simple table, this has the effect of flipping rows and columns.

inputs.name: Path Number Index
inputs.info: Index of number within each path to be replaced with the item list index.

components.summary: 把路径中的某一级与数据项索引互换，效果类似行列转置。

detail.concept: 翻转树的行列关系：把「分支里的项」与「同一位置的项」互换理解，常用于批量转置。
steps: Tree 端接结构规整的树。
输出翻转后的树。

scenes.title: 行列互换
scenes.body: 每一行是一条轴线、每个分支是一条街，翻转后就能按街处理。

pitfalls: 分支长度不一致时翻转会补空或截断，结果长度以最长分支为准。
与 Flatten 完全不同：Flip 保留树结构，Flatten 压成一列。
detail.tip: 「行列搞反了」的直觉，几乎都指向 Flip Tree。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Graft By Key
components.info: Graft all lists in a tree by moving values with shared keys into their own lists.
components.summary: 把具有相同键的值各自归入一条新分支。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Graft Tree
components.info: Graft a tree by moving each value into its own list.
components.summary: 把每个数据项各自放进一条新分支。

detail.concept: 嫁接改变的是结构，不是数值：它把列表里的每一项各自装进一条新分支，于是「一串数据」变成「一堆各自独立的数据」。作用是强制下游逐项配对，而不是按位置配对。
steps: 把列表接到输入。
观察输出：项数不变，但每项都独占一条路径。
把它接到两个输入的其中一个上，下游就会变成「一对一」的全组合关系。

scenes.title: 两列表全组合
scenes.body: 把其中一条列表嫁接后相加，得到 n×m 个和值。
scenes.wiring: 列表 A(嫁接) + 列表 B

scenes.title: 强制逐点生成
scenes.body: 让每个点各自生成一个构件，避免被合并成一条曲线。

pitfalls: 嫁接会让数据量呈乘积增长，几百项就可能变成几万项，先估算再上规模。
嫁接不是「复制」，如果想在每项上生成多个，要配合「重复项」使用。
detail.tip: 记：Graft = 拆成树枝，Flatten = 压回平地，Simplify = 只改门牌号。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Transfer Paths
components.info: Transfer paths from one tree to another.
components.summary: 把一棵树的路径结构套到另一棵树上。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Unflatten Tree
components.info: Unflatten a tree by copying the topology of another tree.

inputs.name: Guide
inputs.info: Guide tree whose topology to copy.

components.summary: 按另一棵树的拓扑把扁平列表重新组织成树。

inputs.name: Wrap Paths
inputs.info: Wrap offset path elements when they exceed path limits.

inputs.name: Wrap Items
inputs.info: Wrap offset item indices when they exceed list limits.

inputs.name: Skip Singletons

components.summary: 在同一棵树内按偏移规则成对选取数据项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Relative Items
components.info: Select pairs of items from different trees using an offset pattern.

inputs.name: Offset Pattern
inputs.info: Offset pattern for path elements and item indices.

inputs.name: Wrap Paths
inputs.info: Wrap offset path elements when they exceed path limits.

inputs.name: Wrap Items
inputs.info: Wrap offset item indices when they exceed list limits.

inputs.name: Skip Singletons
inputs.info: Skip pairs with only a single defined element.

outputs.name: Item A
outputs.info: First item in each pair, picked from the first tree.

outputs.name: Item B
outputs.info: Second item in each pair, picked from the second tree.

components.summary: 在不同树之间按偏移规则成对选取数据项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Split Tree
components.info: Separate all items in a tree based on whether or not they pass path or index rules.

inputs.name: Splitting Rules
inputs.info: Splitting rules to apply to all items in the tree.

inputs.name: Insert Nulls
inputs.info: Insert nulls whenever an item is assigned to the other output.

outputs.name: Positive
outputs.info: All items in the tree which match at least one splitting pattern.

outputs.name: Negative
outputs.info: All items in the tree which match none of the splitting patterns.

components.summary: 按路径或索引规则把树中的数据分成两部分。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dissect Path
components.info: Extract the elements of a data tree path.
components.summary: 把一条数据树路径拆成各级整数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Path From Elements
components.info: Create a data tree path out of integer elements.
components.summary: 用一组整数构造一条数据树路径。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Path From Tree
components.info: Extract a specified path from a data tree.
components.summary: 从数据树中取出指定的那条路径。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Replace Paths
components.info: Replace some or all paths in a tree.

inputs.name: Search
inputs.info: Paths to replace. If omitted, all paths in the tree are replaced one by one.

components.summary: 替换树中部分或全部路径。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tree Paths
components.info: Extract all the paths in a data tree.

outputs.name: Paths
outputs.info: All the paths in the tree.

outputs.name: Simplified Paths
outputs.info: All the paths, but in simplified form.

components.summary: 取出数据树中所有的路径。

detail.concept: 取出树中所有路径。它是排查树结构问题最直接的工具：路径长什么样，决定了数据是「按什么层级」组织的。
steps: 接树。
输出每条分支的路径（形如 {0;1}）。
把路径接给 Panel，肉眼确认层级是否符合预期。

scenes.title: 检查分组层级
scenes.body: 点阵分组后看路径是 {0;0} 还是 {0;0;0}，判断分组多了一层还是少了一层。

pitfalls: 路径数与分支数是同一个概念，但不要和数据项数混淆。
拍平后路径全为空，看不出原结构。
detail.tip: 看不清结构时，先把路径打出来，比猜快得多。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: All Tree Sites
components.info: Harvest all the sites of a data tree.

outputs.name: Sites
outputs.info: All the sites contained within the tree, with original topology.

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Replace Sites
components.info: Replace items in a tree.

inputs.name: Sites
inputs.info: Sites of tree items to be replaced.

components.summary: 把树中的线性序号换算成树位置。

inputs.name: Path
inputs.info: Path for the list within the tree.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item within the list.

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Decode Sites
components.info: Harvest the `Data.Path` and `Data.Index` meta data from all items and recreate the implied tree.
components.summary: 读取数据自带的路径与索引，重建原本的树结构。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Encode Sites
components.info: Assign `Data.Path` and `Data.Index` meta data to all items in a tree based on their current position.
components.summary: 按当前位置为树中每一项写入路径与索引元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Explode Tree
components.info: Explode a tree and redirect each resulting list to a separate output.

outputs.info: This output is not matched to any twig in the tree.
This output is not matched to any twig in the tree.

components.summary: 把树炸开，每条分支单独接到一个输出。

detail.concept: 把一棵树按分支拆成多个独立输出，每个输出是一条分支。相当于把「打包」的结构解开。
steps: Tree 端接树数据。
电池会根据分支数量增减输出端。
每个输出接一个后续操作。

scenes.title: 分组分别建模
scenes.body: 楼层被分成几棵树后拆开，分别给不同的构件参数。
scenes.wiring: 楼层树 → Explode Tree → 各层单独处理

pitfalls: 分支数量变化时输出端不会自动跟着变，容易静默丢数据。
拆开后就失去了「同一棵树」的并行关系，后续合并需要重新组织。
detail.tip: 需要「每一组单独一条逻辑」时用它，需要「统一处理」时别拆。
